headline: Analyzing the Music Lake — reusing 3,324 already-analyzed tracks and processing only the ~1,182 new Mac-only songs, then building 50-60 song DJ sets with energy arcs.
insights: Smart reuse: 3,324 tracks already analyzed from the Walkman run are matched by artist+title and skipped — only the genuinely new Lake songs (The Shaker, DJ Music, extra crates) get processed.

Next step after analysis: segment the Lake into 50-60 song DJ sets, each sequenced to its set-type energy arc — Peak-Time (front-load + peak finish), Warm-Up (rising build), Afterhours (deep + comedown), Sunset (melodic bell curve).
Hybrid organization: mostly genre-based sets, with a few cross-genre journey sets, all harmonically mixed (Camelot) and pointing at the Lake as .m3u8 for rekordbox/Serato.
The Music Lake is the single source now: ~2,530 unique songs consolidated, duplicates trashed, everything stored once.
roadblocks_note: Lake analysis runs locally (no device). iCloud-Drive-paced file moves during cleanup are done. Rate/ETA may read blank on this monitor (device-pull timing doesn't apply to the local run).
next: Finish analyzing the ~1,182 new songs, then auto-build the DJ sets into ~/Desktop/DJ Sets/.
